definitions.explanation: A gaming term for completing a game or section as fast as possible using real time, including all loading times and pauses. Popular in the Japanese gaming community.

examples.japanese: このゲームのRTAに{挑戦|ちょうせん}している。
examples.english: I'm attempting a speedrun of this game.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{記録|きろく}のRTA{動画|どうが}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched a video of the world record speedrun.

examples.japanese: RTAは{練習|れんしゅう}と{運|うん}の{両方|りょうほう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Speedrunning requires both practice and luck.

notes:
RTA (Real-Time Attack) is a speedrunning category that measures total time in real time.

RTA CATEGORIES:
- Any%: {最速|さいそく}クリア (fastest completion, any method)
- 100%: {完全|かんぜん}クリア (all items/objectives)
- Glitchless: バグなし (no exploits)

RELATED TERMS:
- TAS (Tool-Assisted Speedrun): {機械|きかい}による{自動|じどう}プレイ
- {走者|そうしゃ}: speedrunner
- {通|とお}しプレイ: full run (from start to end)
- タイムアタック: time attack

RTA differs from TAS (tool-assisted speedrun) in that RTA is performed by human players in real time without frame-by-frame manipulation.
